text: Which of these is a key technical challenge in the metatheory of HITs?
choices: The general theory of HITs requires a coherent elimination rule for higher constructors (2-paths, etc.), which is not fully settled in the literature
explanation: The elimination rules for HITs with higher constructors (2-cells and above) require coherence conditions. The general theory (Lumsdaine-Shulman, etc.) is an active research area.
